temporalPicker.description: Date, time, and date-time controls with explicit commitment, relative presets, availability rules, and IANA time-zone handling.
temporalPicker.customDateFormatHint: Use formatValue to customize the trigger while retaining the original ISO date value.
temporalPicker.customTimeFormatHint: The same callback can format a time trigger without changing the committed ISO time.
temporalPicker.singleTimeHint: Choose one wall-clock time and receive an ISO time string.
temporalPicker.rangeTimeHint: Choose start and end times for shifts, business hours, and similar windows.
temporalPicker.singleDateHint: Choose one calendar day without a time-zone offset.
temporalPicker.rangeDateHint: Choose consecutive calendar dates and commit a from/to value.
temporalPicker.singleDateTimeHint: Choose one calendar date and exact time in the configured time zone.
temporalPicker.rangeDateTimeHint: Choose start and end date-times as an RFC 3339 instant range.
temporalPicker.chooseDateTimeRange: Choose a date and time range
temporalPicker.commitmentBody: Use complete for a direct selection or apply when a range, preset, or availability rule should remain a private draft until the user confirms it. Preset behavior and close-on-commit are independent.
temporalPicker.timeZoneBody: Date-time values are RFC 3339 instants. The picker converts them to the supplied IANA time zone, explicitly asks the user to resolve repeated local times, and rejects local times skipped by daylight-saving changes.
temporalPicker.p0: Controlled committed value. Date and time pickers expose branded ISO strings; range pickers expose a from/to pair.
temporalPicker.p1: Initial committed value for uncontrolled use.
temporalPicker.p2: Called only when a value is committed. Context identifies calendar, time field, preset, Apply, or Clear.
temporalPicker.p3: Complete commits a valid selection immediately; Apply retains a local draft until confirmation.
temporalPicker.p4: Auto uses a popover on larger pointer devices and a drawer on touch or narrow screens.
temporalPicker.p5: Named values resolved once on activation. A preset may be drafted or committed independently of closeOnCommit.
temporalPicker.p6: Controls displayed date and time formatting plus the calendar language tag.
temporalPicker.p7: Injects the reference instant used when resolving relative presets.
temporalPicker.p8: Disabled blocks interaction; read-only renders the committed summary without an editable trigger.
temporalPicker.p9: Formats only the committed value shown by the trigger or read-only summary. It does not change the emitted ISO value; date-time formatters also receive the resolved IANA time zone.
